features:
HERSHEY'S MILK CHOCOLATE TASTE: A delicious artificially flavored chocolate frosting that's perfect for baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

A TRUSTED FAVORITE: This Betty Crocker frosting is the perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

CONTAINS: One 16 oz tub of Betty Crocker Artificially Flavored HERSHEY'S Milk Chocolate Premium Frosting
ingredients: Sugar, Water, Palm Oil, Corn Syrup, Hershey's Cocoa, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Corn Starch. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Polysorbate 60, Citric Acid, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
